answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in nadir, expire in timber, and cipher lists each expiry. Someone running 123 aliases therefore needs 49 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 928 identities would post 3912 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
